nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A roadmap update turned into a useful little course repair: the plan for skills is clearer, and the roadmap can now safely cross S105.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Keep #431 Phase 1 deterministic: scan, list, validate, and record skills before adding smarter recommendations.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The existing legacy half-sprint encoding collided with real post-S100 sprint numbers ending in 5.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S114 has a clean, scoped path for the skill registry MVP.

bunker_locations: Roadmap IDs ending in 5 after S100 must stay canonical; legacy encoded half-sprint support should not shadow real sprints like S105.
